page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6v-c10g1.20xlarge is a dedicated GPU-accelerated compute instance designed for heavy parallel processing. Built on the KVM hypervisor and an x86_64 architecture, the instance is powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor providing 82 dedicated vCPUs clocked at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The host allocates 336.0 GB of system memory, which provides approximately 4.1 GB of RAM per vCPU. Accelerated computation is driven by eight NVIDIA V100 GPUs delivering an aggregate of 128 GB of high-bandwidth VRAM with 16 GiB per GPU.

Networking for this instance features a baseline bandwidth of 35 Gbps, supporting significant node-to-node data transfers and distributed workflows. The instance provides no bundled local storage, meaning that all persistent disk storage must be provisioned through remote network block storage. In addition, zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default, requiring external networking components for public network access.

The allocation of eight discrete accelerators alongside high dedicated core density positions this instance for intensive multi-GPU computing. Given the lack of local NVMe storage, data pipeline throughput is bound to network storage performance and the 35 Gbps baseline interconnect. The server profile is best suited for distributed deep learning training, large-scale neural network inference, molecular modeling, high-performance scientific simulations, and enterprise parallel compute workloads.

It features 82 dedicated vCPUs backed by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz, paired with 336.0 GB of system memory at 4.1 GB per core. The hardware configuration integrates eight NVIDIA V100 GPUs offering a cumulative 128 GB of VRAM to handle demanding parallel computing requirements. High-throughput data movement is supported by a 35 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The instance does not include local disk storage, necessitating external network-attached volumes for persistent data operations, and comes with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. With dense GPU acceleration and massive dedicated host compute capacity, this server type is specifically built for distributed deep learning model training, AI inference, molecular dynamics, scientific simulations, and compute-intensive enterprise graphics or analytical workloads.
